## Visceral Leishmaniasis mortality

At the **Kenya National Public Health Institute**, I analysed epidemiological data from Kenya's Visceral Leishmaniasis outbreak. I compared **mortality across clinical treatment regimens** to guide targeted public health interventions.

## School outbreaks in Kakamega County

I investigated water-borne and hand-swelling disease outbreaks in Kakamega County schools. I developed **standardised case definitions** and reviewed national reporting frameworks so that cases would be counted consistently.

## Surveillance systems assessment

I trained in Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR) and took part in the Africa CDC, KNPHI and Ministry of Health workshop on **toolkit assessment, surveillance system mapping and gap analysis**.

## Hospital surveillance tool

At **Kenyatta University Teaching, Referral and Research Hospital**, I designed and implemented a **hospital-wide surveillance tool**. It simplified data collection for the public health department and sped up analysis for infection-control decisions. I also carried out environmental health compliance audits on all wards to find gaps that raise the risk of hospital-acquired infections.

## Mpox

I helped with outbreak investigation, analysis and **contact tracing for Mpox** within the hospital.

## Cholera GIS workshop

Through the USIU-Africa EpiBio Club, I led a workshop on using **environmental exposure indices, WASH data and spatial modelling** to map and predict cholera outbreaks in Kenya's informal settlements.
